summary: Unit test asserts the exact NO_PROXY/no_proxy literals in the docker run argv (both spellings, positioned after --env-file) and would reject an emission that omits the service host, uses the full URL, drops env-file or lowercase bypass entries, or is ordered before --env-file; the real-CLI test adds a positive control (proxy hit without bypass) then proves zero proxy hits and only Bearer-authenticated target hits once the runner's emitted values are applied.
